records.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
records.context: Kurushima confronts Maria's fleet. Yukihisa speaks up, Kurushima tries to intimidate Maria, and she answers him with ridicule before he threatens her.
records.Japanese:
FIのあねさんよ！
今日こそは決着をつけさせてもらうぜ！
records.source_meaning: Kurushima taunts Maria by name and demands a decisive fight today.
records.english: Well, FI! Today we settle this for good!
records.previous_English: Well, FI! Today we settle this for good!
records.localization_note: The taunt and declaration open the confrontation. Keep the original given-name token.

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.context: Kurushima confronts Maria's fleet. Yukihisa speaks up, Kurushima tries to intimidate Maria, and she answers him with ridicule before he threatens her.
records.Japanese:
クルシマ！
愚かな所行はやめよ！
records.source_meaning: Yukihisa calls out to Kurushima and tells him to stop his foolish conduct.
records.localization_note: The blunt rebuke sounds right as Yukihisa interrupts his challenge.

records.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
records.context: Kurushima confronts Maria's fleet. Yukihisa speaks up, Kurushima tries to intimidate Maria, and she answers him with ridicule before he threatens her.
records.Japanese:
てめえ、侍のくせに
異国人の肩ぁ持ちやがって！
武士の風上にもおけねえ野郎だ！
records.source_meaning: Kurushima accuses a fellow samurai of siding with foreigners and disgracing his class.
records.english: A samurai siding with foreigners? You're a disgrace!
records.previous_English: A samurai siding with foreigners? You're a disgrace!
records.localization_note: Keep the contemptuous question and accusation in Kurushima's voice.

records.speaker: Yukihisa Shiraki
records.context: Kurushima confronts Maria's fleet. Yukihisa speaks up, Kurushima tries to intimidate Maria, and she answers him with ridicule before he threatens her.
records.Japanese:
大陸の沿岸を荒らし、無抵抗の民から
略奪するは
誇り高き武士の為すことか！
records.source_meaning: Yukihisa challenges Kurushima to justify raiding the mainland coast and robbing defenseless people as a proud samurai.
records.english: You raid the mainland coast and rob people who can't fight back. Is that the way of a proud samurai?
records.previous_English: You raid the mainland coast and rob people who can't fight back. Is that how a proud samurai behaves?
records.localization_note: Yukihisa answers the insult by invoking a samurai's code of conduct. The whole question stays together after the two direct charges.
protected_phrases: Is that the way of a proud samurai?

records.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
records.context: Kurushima confronts Maria's fleet. Yukihisa speaks up, Kurushima tries to intimidate Maria, and she answers him with ridicule before he threatens her.
records.Japanese:
おーおー、お堅えことを
俺の一番嫌いな性格だぜ
records.source_meaning: Kurushima mocks Yukihisa's stiff manner and says that is the kind of person he hates.
records.english: Oh, listen to you. So stiff and proper. Just the sort I can't stand.
records.previous_English: Oh, listen to you. So stiff and proper. Just the sort I can't stand.
records.localization_note: Keep the sneer, the mock appraisal and the personal dismissal. Each beat can sit on its own row without separating the last clause.
protected_phrases: Just the sort I can't stand.

records.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
records.context: Kurushima confronts Maria's fleet. Yukihisa speaks up, Kurushima tries to intimidate Maria, and she answers him with ridicule before he threatens her.
records.Japanese:
へっへっへ、FIよ！
俺の女になるなら、おとなしく降参
してもいいぞ！
おめえの命だけは助けてやろう！
records.source_meaning: Kurushima says Maria can surrender without resisting if she agrees to be his woman. He will spare only her.
records.english: Heh heh, FI! Be mine, and you can surrender quietly. I'll spare you and no one else!
records.previous_English: Heh heh, FI! Agree to be mine and I'll let you surrender without a fight. Yours is the only life I'll spare!
records.localization_note: Kurushima makes his silence-and-surrender offer directly to Maria. She can surrender on his terms and he promises to spare her alone. Keep the given-name token.
protected_phrases: I'll spare you and no one else!

records.speaker: Maria Li
records.context: Kurushima confronts Maria's fleet. Yukihisa speaks up, Kurushima tries to intimidate Maria, and she answers him with ridicule before he threatens her.
records.Japanese:
ソウジン・クルシマ…
それ以上無駄口を叩くようなら、その
威気高な髭をむしり取ってあげるわ
records.source_meaning: Maria says she will pluck Kurushima's imposing beard if he keeps talking nonsense.
records.english: Sojin Kurushima... Mouth off again and I'll pluck out that high-and-mighty beard!
records.previous_English: Sojin Kurushima... Mouth off again and I'll pluck out that high-and-mighty beard!
records.localization_note: The insulting threat ridicules his pretension and rejects his offer in Maria's voice.

records.speaker: Sojin Kurushima
records.context: Kurushima confronts Maria's fleet. Yukihisa speaks up, Kurushima tries to intimidate Maria, and she answers him with ridicule before he threatens her.
records.Japanese:
がっはっはっは！
……ぶち殺ーす！！
records.source_meaning: Kurushima laughs, pauses, then threatens to kill her.
records.localization_note: The bitter turn from laughter to an explicit threat closes the exchange.
